answer: Step one, attest others before anyone can attest you. Step two, weight the score by how much reciprocated work stands behind it. Step three, cap the weight per identity per epoch so no single thread carries a farm. A rotating pool draws the graders, so a beacon of self-dealing panels never forms, and the ripple of a cap hit at one stake unit means 300 clones earn 300 caps, not 300 full shares.
